faqs.q: Can Myntmore reach European and US chemical buyers who require REACH or ISO compliance?
faqs.a: Yes. We build outreach specifically highlighting your plant's regulatory readiness, certifications, and capacity so procurement teams in the EU and US engage seriously.

faqs.q: How do you identify companies that actually consume our specific chemicals?
faqs.a: We map exact downstream application industries (coatings, textiles, agro, water treatment, pharma, plastics) and verify raw-material procurement and R&D heads inside those manufacturers.

faqs.q: Can we target global chemical distributors as well as direct end-use manufacturers?
faqs.a: Yes. We can run dual tracks: one targeting direct industrial formulators for higher margins, and one shortlisting stocking distributors in target export regions.

faqs.q: Will outreach protect our company's primary email domain?
faqs.a: Yes. All cold email sends run on dedicated, warmed secondary domains with full SPF, DKIM, and DMARC authentication.

faqs.q: Do you work with smaller GIDC specialty chemical units as well as large exporters?
faqs.a: Yes, provided you have clear export or domestic B2B capacity and deal sizes that support a managed B2B outbound system. We assess exact fit on a free 30-minute audit.
